Registered Nurse - ICU (Night Shift)

Facility: St. Brigid Medical Center
Location: Austin, TX
Job type: Full-time
Pay: $38 - $52 per hour depending on experience
Start date: 16 November 2026

Shift differential of $4 per hour applies to nights and weekends. Sign-on bonus of $5,000 for
nurses with two or more years of ICU experience.

Qualifications
- Active Texas or compact state RN license
- BLS and ACLS certification
- Minimum 1 year of acute care experience
- BSN preferred

You will care for critically ill adults, working with intensivists and respiratory therapists.
St. Brigid is an equal opportunity employer.
